changes: latency_base 2 s -> 0.5 s, latency_adverse 62 s -> 60.5 s
stop exits re-priced in the virtual ledger (see stop_fill_repricing)
time-exit anchor is the signal bar close, not the entry fill (an entry fill 1 s after a 15m boundary would otherwise add a whole extra bar)
orders are reduce-only for stops/exits; stops cancelled on exit
time bars are built with no fabricated flat bars (time_bars_build_with_no_updates=False)
amendments.reason: Engine-mechanics prototype on synthetic orders (no strategy, no performance computed): a 2 s latency filled at the +20 s path point (a bar extreme), not the next open; and a triggered stop fills at the crossing path quote (minute extreme).

changes: F05 requires >= 24 of the 30 opening-range minutes to be valid, else NO_TRADE
amendments.reason: An opening range built from a mostly empty window would be wrong data, not a signal.

changes: F01, F04, F06, F07 displacement statistic is now z_k = (C_t - C_{t-k}) / (ATR14 * sqrt(k))
F07 impulse threshold 3.0 -> 1.5 so that F01, F06 and F07 use the same 1.5 (about 2.4 sigma_k) strength
F04 keeps the numeric strength-gap 3.0 but on the sqrt(k)-normalised strengths
amendments_continued.motivation_disclosure: signal frequency observed on DEVELOPMENT data; the decision rests on random-walk arithmetic, not on any profit or loss
amendments_continued.reason: A DEV-window smoke test of F01 (code debugging only; its P&L is not used) showed 92 signals in two weeks. Cause: a k-bar displacement was divided by a ONE-bar ATR. Under a random walk ATR14 ~ 1.6 sigma_bar, so |disp/ATR| >= 1.5 over 4 bars is only ~1.2 sigma_k and fires on ~12% of bars: not an 'established move'. Thresholds must be stated in horizon-scaled volatility units.

changes: every arm is run twice: GOVERNED (all capital rules exactly as specified; result = what the EUR 500 account would have done) and RESEARCH (sizing equity fixed at the initial EUR 500, drawdown pause disabled, all other gates and the daily loss limit on)
evidence classification uses the RESEARCH run measured in R; GOVERNED results are reported alongside
amendments_continued.reason: The 10% drawdown pause is a capital-protection control; applying it inside the statistical evaluation truncates the trade sample after the first bad stretch and makes edge estimates depend on path luck.

capital_and_risk.cost_gate: reject if expected_round_trip_cost_eur / risk_eur > 0.20 (same ceiling as frozen FRONT-1 policy)
capital_and_risk.drawdown_basis: peak-to-trough on realized equity; pause = no new entries for the rest of the run
capital_and_risk.equity_used_for_sizing: realized virtual equity only; the IBKR paper balance is never read
capital_and_risk.min_units_rule: if computed units < min_order_units the trade is REJECTED (never rounded up)
capital_and_risk.sizing_formula: units = floor_to_step( risk_eur / ((stop_distance + spread_now + slippage_allowance) * eur_per_quote_unit) )

common_definitions.ATR_n: simple mean of the last n true ranges (needs n+1 contiguous bars), as in the FRONT-1 stop calculation
common_definitions.TR: max(H-L, |H-C_prev|, |L-C_prev|) on MID bars of the stated timeframe
common_definitions.stop_distance: stop_multiple * ATR_14 of the stated stop timeframe, applied to the actual entry fill price
common_definitions.z_move_k: (C_t - C_{t-k}) / (ATR_14 * sqrt(k)) on the stated timeframe (A3)

costs.carry: not modeled (positions never held across the 16:55 New York force-flat); stated limitation
costs.commission_rate_note: fraction of notional in quote currency; 0.000026 ~= USD 3 per 100k EUR notional at EURUSD ~1.17

provenance.commission: BROKER_SCHEDULE (Pepperstone GmbH cTrader Razor: USD 3 per side per 100k, Sept 2026 fee schedule, vendor-published; broker NOT yet selected)

data.base_series: native 1-minute BID and ASK candles (bar-open, left-labeled, UTC)
data.session_reset_rule: all indicator state resets when consecutive valid minutes are > 60 min apart (weekend / outage); no look-back spans a gap
data.signal_price: MID OHLC = (bid+ask)/2 at each of open/high/low/close
data.tf_aggregation: UTC-aligned, left-closed, left-labeled; a bar completes only when its final minute is received; empty buckets produce no bar
data.valid_minute_rule: bid_volume > 0 or ask_volume > 0; zero-volume minutes carry no information and are never replayed or fabricated

evidence_rules.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: unique episodes (DEV+VAL+OOS) < 30 OR unique episodes in VALIDATION+OUT_OF_SAMPLE < 15
evidence_rules.MIXED_EVIDENCE: sufficient data that satisfies neither NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE nor PROMISING_RESEARCH
evidence_rules.NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE: sufficient data AND base-cost pooled VAL+OOS mean net R < 0 AND (bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 OR mean net R < 0 in all of DEV, VAL, OOS)
evidence_rules.PROMISING_RESEARCH: sufficient data AND base-cost mean net R > 0 in each of DEV, VAL and OOS AND pooled VAL+OOS bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND pooled VAL+OOS profit factor >= 1.2 AND positive mean net R in >= 4 of 7 pairs
evidence_rules.SHADOW_FORWARD_ELIGIBLE: PROMISING_RESEARCH AND adverse-cost pooled VAL+OOS mean net R > 0 AND max drawdown < 10% AND >= 100 unique episodes AND >= 30 unique episodes in OOS AND positive mean net R in >= 2 of 3 volatility terciles
evidence_rules.episodes: trades are grouped into independent episodes: a trade joins an open episode if its entry is within 60 min of the episode's latest entry AND shares a currency exposure with the same net direction; otherwise it starts a new episode
evidence_rules.multiplicity: eight strategy arms are tested (F01-F07 plus the pre-declared F07 reversal mirror); no multiple-testing correction is applied, which makes any positive finding weaker, not stronger
evidence_rules.unit: net result in R = net P&L (EUR) / planned risk (EUR); sizing path effects are removed

execution_timing.decision: on completion of the signal-timeframe bar
execution_timing.intrabar_path: open -> extreme nearer the open -> other extreme -> close (Nautilus bar_adaptive_high_low_ordering heuristic), applied to bid and ask candles separately
execution_timing.non_stop_exits: evaluated only on completed bars, executed as reduce-only MARKET at the next open (never as resting limit orders)
execution_timing.note: Base fill = first quote after decision+0.5s = the next minute's OPEN bid/ask (the open quote is emitted at +1s). No same-bar-close fill is permitted. Adverse = one bar later (arrival at +60.5s lands before the following minute's open quote at +61s).
execution_timing.protective_stop: native reduce-only STOP_MARKET submitted immediately on entry fill (bid-triggered for longs, ask-triggered for shorts); cancelled on any other exit; if the venue rejects it the position is closed at market immediately
execution_timing.stop_fill_repricing: the engine fills a triggered stop at the quote that crossed it; on a 4-point minute path that quote is often the minute extreme, which would overstate losses. The virtual ledger therefore re-prices stop exits: if the trigger quote is the minute-open quote (gap through the stop) the engine fill is kept (plus the extra stop slippage); otherwise the exit is booked at the stop price minus slippage_pips_stop. The correction is reported per run as ledger_minus_engine_eur.
execution_timing.time_exit_anchor: first signal-timeframe boundary >= signal bar close + max_holding_minutes

partitions.method: 55/20/15/10 calendar-fraction split, as in fast_fx_v2_partitions.json, fixed from the date range before any returns were computed
partitions.rule: Code correctness may be debugged on DEVELOPMENT only. VALIDATION/OUT_OF_SAMPLE/RESERVED_FORWARD results are produced exactly once, after spec hashes are committed. No parameter may change after that without a new strategy_version.

session_filters.force_flat: all positions closed at market at 16:55 America/New_York (also guarantees flat before the Friday close; no swap/rollover modeled)
session_filters.no_new_entries: from 16:30 to 19:00 America/New_York (rollover spread blow-outs; max observed 19.6-30 pip closes)
session_filters.session_model: classify_session (zoneinfo, DST-correct): ASIA / LONDON / NEW_YORK / LONDON_NEW_YORK_OVERLAP / ROLLOVER_LOW_LIQUIDITY / OTHER
